en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic rural landscape with rolling, hedge‑lined fields, a dirt path, and dense tree‑covered hills. A thatched or light‑roofed building is partly visible among the trees on the left, while taller trees crown the hill on the right. The printed caption in Dutch appears in red at the bottom margin, with smaller publisher information beneath.
